synopsis.text: The Vision discovers that Ultron played a significant role in his transformation from human to sentient A.I. Moondragon tells Mantis that she is the runner-up “Celestial Madonna”, should Mantis prove unworthy of the title.
Features the Hostess Fruit Pies ad, Spider-Man In The Trap
This is the first Hostess ad to appear in this title, they would continue to appear for the next seven years, with a total of 73 ads, ending with The Avengers #218, April 1982.
